Die fino analytics GmbH ist Teil der fino Unternehmensgruppe, die 2015 mit dem ersten digitalen und vollautomatisierten Kontowechsel der FinTech-Branche gestartet ist. Heute zählt fino zu den Innovationstreibern in den Bereichen Konto- und Datenanalyse, Regulatorik, Steuern und Dokumentenmanagement. Unsere Mission ist es, Daten einen Wert zu geben. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Professional Services (German Speaking)
jobs.description:
Professional Services Senior Project Manager (German Speaking)

Location: Germany (Remote)

Department: Professional Services (PS)

Language Requirements: German Speaking. 

About the Job 
Rubrik Professional Services is looking for a high-energy, strategic, and results-driven Senior Project Manager to lead complex, enterprise customer implementations and help shape the future of our delivery practice. In this role, you will be customer-facing, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure deployment success, business value realisation, and operational efficiency. You will own high-stakes client engagements end-to-end, bringing deep project management expertise to solve problems on the ground and drive customer outcomes with minimal oversight.

About You 
As a Senior Project Manager in our PS Organisation, you will drive impact primarily through hands-on delivery excellence, leadership, and practice enablement.

1. Client Delivery Excellence
● Drive Complex Engagements: Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, concurrent, enterprise-level customer projects from kickoff to sign-off within fast-paced environments.
● Scope & Milestone Management: Prepare enterprise customers for deployment, establish clear success criteria, track deliverables, set targets, manage resources, and ensure project execution adheres to deadlines and budgets.
● Risk & Issue Governance: Proactively identify, track, and mitigate project risks and technical dependencies, resolving issues autonomously before they escalate.
● Stakeholder Alignment: Serve as the single point of contact and escalation owner for customer executives, cross-functional internal teams (Engineering, Customer Support, Sales), and third- party partners.
● Quality & Performance: Execute quality control throughout project lifecycles to ensure deliverables meet or exceed Rubrik's standards and customer business objectives.

2. PMO & Process Optimisation
● Partner with PS leadership to help build, refine, and maintain the PMO governance framework, including standard operating procedures, project methodologies, and key performance indicators.
● Continuous Improvement: Flag bottlenecks and recommend improvements that enhance operational efficiency, margins, and customer satisfaction.
● Assist in establishing best practices for your engagements, resource allocation, utilisation tracking, and project health reporting across the PS portfolio.

Required Qualifications:
● 8+ years of direct Project Management experience delivering customer-facing, enterprise technical projects within a Professional Services or Consulting organisation.
● Previous experience with managing customers from Financial Services, Government, Healthcare industries
● Track record of managing multiple complex, high-visibility client engagements concurrently in a fast-paced technology environment.
● Demonstrated ability to work autonomously, exercising strong judgment and decision-making in ambiguous, high-pressure customer situations.
● Expert knowledge of modern project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet, Jira, Confluence, Asana) as well as Google Workspace.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Position

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Acquisitions & Onboarding team, a domain that touches every customer who plays on FanDuel. You'll work closely with engineering and design to bring initiatives from scoping through delivery, while also contributing to the bigger questions of what we build and why — assessing opportunities, shaping priorities, and utilizing using data to inform decisions.

The Product Manager ensures successful product performance through market analysis, a deep understanding of customer needs, data analysis and reporting. Initiatives will be a mix of back-end and front-end work, with a focus on data recommendations, cutting edge technology and ease of use. There is a great opportunity to work across a range of expert teams to achieve your outcomes.

In addition to the specific responsibilities outlined above, employees may be required to perform other such duties as assigned by the Company. This ensures operational flexibility and allows the Company to meet evolving business needs.

 

THE GAME PLAN
Everyone on our team has a part to play

  • Work within a collaborative environment, liaising closely with an extensive list of stakeholders including engineering, marketing, commercial, design & product analytics
  • Contribute to product discovery and prioritization, helping assess opportunities and shape the roadmap alongside your team
  • Build and maintain relationships across engineering, design, data, operations, and other stakeholders to drive alignment and remove blockers
  • Track product performance and use data to identify what's working, what isn't, and what to do about it
  • Develop expertise in the onboarding domain and stay curious about how our product, customers, and landscape evolve
  • Be responsible for eliciting requirements, in the form of user stories & acceptance criteria, prioritizing the product backlog to streamline the execution of program priorities while maintaining the conceptual and technical integrity of the features or components
  • Establish and maintain domain expertise including complex process flows and legal and regulatory requirements for our industry.
  • Drive through effective and sustainable change and guide the business through the journey.
  • Play an integral role in a self-organizing agile delivery team, ensuring solutions adhere to state regulations for our products while serving the needs of each of our products (Sportsbook, Fantasy Sports, Predicts, Racing, and Casino).
  • Understand and communicate the problem whilst putting the customers experience of the product first.

What We’re Looking For

What we’re looking for in our next teammate

    • Bachelor’s degree preferred
    • 2+ years in a product management or product-adjacent role; prior PM title not required
    • Excellent numerical and analytical skills with the ability to interpret data quickly to inform the right decisions
    • Experience working with engineering and/or design teams, even in a supporting capacity
    • Naturally resourceful — you ask questions, seek out the right people, and find a path forward even when the answer isn't obvious
    • Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to make sense of data and present your thinking clearly across different audiences
    • Comfortable managing priorities and working through ambiguity
    • Don’t check all the boxes? That’s okay! We encourage you to still apply if you feel like you possess an adjacent skill set and are interested in learning more about this position.

 

What You Can Expect

  • Interesting work - working in a fast-paced and ever-changing industry, new problems and exciting solutions are never too far away. There are always opportunities to learn new skills and broaden your horizons
  • A sense of achievement - Our teams own their own software and when that awesome new feature ships to users and the positive feedback starts rolling in, you can feel really proud of what you and your team created
  • Personal development - clear and defined career pathways for every role at every level, a supportive manager, loads of learning opportunities and even 10% of your time to dedicate to your learning.

It provides coordinated liquidity, custody, compliance, risk management, and settlement capabilities, reducing operational complexity for fintechs, banks, brokerages, and payment providers.
 Payward's Payments & Blockchain team owns the first and last mile of every dollar that moves in or out of its products. That means dozens of banking partners, PSPs and local rails powering deposits and withdrawals for millions of users.

 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. 
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. 
 
 Why Join Us? 
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. 
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. 
 Are you ready to be part of the future? 
 
 About the job 
 Keet is a fully peer-to-peer messaging and video calling app built on Holepunch's P2P stack. There are no servers, no middlemen, and no data harvesting. People talk directly to each other, with end-to-end encryption by design. 
 
 We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to own the vision for Keet and lead it to a billion users, competing head-on with WhatsApp and Telegram. This is not a maintenance role. You will define where Keet goes, convince the board and the team that it is the right direction, and then drive the execution that gets it there. 
 
 You are a rare combination of three things. You are a product visionary who has shipped consumer chat or calling apps at scale. You are a technologist who can go deep on P2P architecture and the Pear / Holepunch stack (docs.pears.com). And you are a hands-on builder who uses AI tools to prototype and prove concepts in days, not months. You set the bar high, move at incredible speed, and lead from the front. 
 
 You will also be the person who catches what others miss. The PM who thrives here reads every ticket, tracks every dependency, asks the uncomfortable question before it becomes a launch incident, and keeps five workstreams moving simultaneously without losing the thread on any of them. 
 
 If you prefer a PM role where you set strategy and delegate execution, this is not the right fit. If you want to build something that ships to real users, moves markets, and carries your fingerprints from concept to production, we want to hear from you. 
 
 Responsibilities
 
 Vision & Strategy 
 Own and articulate the long-term product vision for Keet as the world's leading private, peer-to-peer communication app, with a clear path to 1 billion users. 

 Analyze WhatsApp, Telegram, Signal, LINE, WeChat and emerging competitors to identify where P2P gives Keet an unfair advantage, and build the roadmap around it. 

 Present product vision, strategy, metrics and progress to the board and executive leadership with clarity and conviction. 

 Define a growth strategy across acquisition, activation, retention and virality, with measurable targets at every stage. 
 
 Technical Product Leadership 
 Develop a deep working understanding of the Holepunch P2P stack (Pear runtime, Bare, Hypercore, Hyperswarm, HyperDHT, Autobase, Hyperbee) and translate its capabilities and constraints into product decisions. 

 Partner with core engineering on hard P2P problems at scale, including NAT traversal, offline sync, multi-device support, large groups, push notifications, and battery and data efficiency on mobile. 

 Own the real-time calling experience (1:1 and group voice and video, plus screen sharing) to a quality bar that matches or beats Google Meet an

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.   

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager in Legal Tech (Zurich)
jobs.description:
Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. 
 You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. 

 Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence  
 Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. 

 Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. 

 Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. 

 Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 

 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership  
 Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. 

 Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). 

 Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. 

 Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 

 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement  
 Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. 

 Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. 

 Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. 

 What We Want to Achieve Together 
 In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. 
 In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. 

 Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. 

 Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. 

 Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. 

 Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data. 

 AI-savvy: crafty with AI tools and automations — you use them daily and keep exploring what's new. 

 A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. 

 Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. 

 

 Why us? Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else. 

 A platform to build your own visible profile as a voice in Legal AI. 

 Modern office in Leipzig or Berlin, hybrid setup, with regular presence in Zürich and team events such as hiking, dinners and offsites. 

 Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) participation. 

 Competitive salary, based on experience and seniority. 

 

 Process 30 min with our People & Operations Manager: cultural fit, understanding the role and your expectations. 

 Positioning conversation with our Head of Product: bring a point of view on Legal AI and be ready to defend it live. 

 Case study: show us something you’ve written or built, and how you’d turn it into a sales-ready asset. 

 Meet the team in the office. 

 Decision: if it’s mutual, we welcome you to the team!

jobs.title: Product Owner mit KI Fokus (m/w/d) | 40.000 € - 60.000 € Jahresgehalt
jobs.description:
Das sind wir. 

 Fitness-Tracker zeigen uns buchstäblich auf Schritt und Tritt, wie es um unsere Bewegungsbilanz steht. Mit Cheftresor haben wir eine Plattform geschaffen, die genau das für die Kennzahlen von Unternehmen leistet. Sie ermöglicht Steuerberatern, vorausschauend zu agieren, und Unternehmen, ihre Daten effektiv und gewinnbringend zu nutzen.

 Bei Cheftresor dreht sich alles um Innovation und Fortschritt. Unsere Mission: Unternehmen und Steuerberater mit smarten Softwarelösungen zu stärken und ihre Zusammenarbeit grundlegend zu transformieren. Als junges Unternehmen, das gleichzeitig auf über 30 Jahre Erfahrung im Bereich Buchhaltung und Controlling zurückgreift, entwickeln wir Tools, die echten Mehrwert schaffen.

 Doch Innovation allein ist nicht alles – wir setzen genauso auf ein wertschätzendes und motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld, in dem sich jeder individuell entfalten kann. Bei uns steht Teamwork an erster Stelle: keine Ellenbogenmentalität, sondern ein agiles Miteinander, das Veränderung bewirkt und Türen öffnet.

 Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich!

 Aufgaben

 Das erwartet dich. 

 Im Rahmen unseres neuen Software-Projekts nimmst du eine tragende Rolle ein. Diese umfasst die technische Realisierung von Änderungen und Neuerungen in Abstimmung mit dem Entwicklerteam sowie die Implementierung von Schnittstellen und den technischen Support unserer Nutzer. Außerdem erwarten dich folgende Aufgaben:

 
 Du gestaltest und entwickelst unsere Plattform „Cheftresor“ mit unserem KI-First-Ansatz kontinuierlich weiter.

 Im Team arbeitest du innovative Ideen aus und optimierst bestehende Services.

 Du pflegst, strukturierst und priorisierst das Product Backlog.

 Du verfasst User Stories, legst Akzeptanzkriterien fest und übernimmst die Verantwortung für die Abnahme.

 Du bist verantwortlich für das Stakeholder-Management und stellst sicher, dass alle Beteiligten auf dem aktuellen Stand sind.

 
 Qualifikation

 Das bringst du mit. 

 Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Product Owner (m/w/d), der mit Leidenschaft neue, digitale Wege geht und innovative Lösungen vorantreibt. Neben einem (Hochschul-) Abschluss, idealerweise in den Bereichen Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet, bringst du folgende Qualifikationen mit:

 
 Du hast bereits mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Produktentwicklung oder agiler Projektarbeit.

 Du kennst dich sehr gut in der Anwendung und Nutzung von KI aus.

 Du hast bereits Erfahrung als Product Owner oder als Teil eines eingespielten Softwareentwicklungsteams gesammelt.

 Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

 Develop and articulate a clear product narrative: why this feature matters, who it serves, and how it connects to the broader platform vision. 

 Navigate the regulatory landscape (FDA, CE marking) as a stakeholder, you do not need to be a regulatory expert, but you must understand how regulatory requirements shape product decisions and timelines.

 Strong conceptual and systems thinking. You can see the big picture, connect disparate inputs into a coherent product thesis, and reason about second-order effects. You don't just execute, you think. 

 Startup or high-growth experience. You have worked in an environment where speed, ambiguity, and wearing multiple hats were the norm, not the exception. 

 Excellent communication skills. You can write clearly, present a compelling argument, and facilitate productive discussions with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

 Comfort with technical depth. You do not need to write code, but you should be able to engage meaningfully with engineers and data scientists on architecture, data, and tradeoff discussions. 

 Intellectual curiosity and learning agility. You pick up new domains quickly and enjoy becoming a quasi-expert in areas you previously knew nothing about. 

 Fluency in English (native or professional proficiency required - C1 level or higher)

 Exposure to FDA 510(k), De Novo, or CE marking processes for software as a medical device (SaMD).

 Manage timelines, dependencies, risks, capacity, and technical trade-offs.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Healthcare (H/F)
jobs.description:
Withings est une entreprise française pionnière de la santé connectée. Depuis 2008, nous concevons des produits et services qui permettent à chacun de mieux comprendre sa santé et aux professionnels de santé de mieux accompagner leurs patients.
 Balances connectées, montres, tensiomètres, dispositifs médicaux et services digitaux : nos technologies sont aujourd’hui utilisées par des millions de personnes et s’intègrent de plus en plus au parcours de soin.
 Nous cherchons aujourd’hui un(e) Product Manager Healthcare pour contribuer au développement de nos produits et services de santé, notamment autour du Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), du suivi des maladies chroniques et de nouveaux parcours de soin digitaux.
 
 Vos responsabilités 
 Comprendre les besoins des patients, médecins et équipes de soin et les transformer en solutions simples et efficaces.
 Concevoir de nouvelles fonctionnalités Healthcare, en particulier autour du Remote Patient Monitoring et du suivi des maladies chroniques. 
 Développer des outils permettant aux professionnels de santé de mieux exploiter les données Withings, de gagner du temps et d'améliorer la qualité du suivi patient.
 Imaginer des parcours patients favorisant l'engagement, l'éducation thérapeutique et l'adoption de comportements favorables à leur santé.
 Définir la vision produit, les priorités et la roadmap en collaboration avec les équipes Engineering, Design, Medical, Data et Business.
 Définir et suivre les KPI permettant de mesurer l'utilisation et l'impact réel des fonctionnalités développées.
 Étudier le marché, les usages et les évolutions du secteur de la santé digitale afin d'identifier de nouvelles opportunités.
 Transformer rapidement des idées en prototypes afin de les confronter aux utilisateurs avant d'investir dans leur développement.
 Nous recherchons un profil capable d'aller au-delà de la définition fonctionnelle d'un produit.
 Les outils d'IA générative transforment profondément la manière de construire des produits. Nous attendons du Product Manager qu'il sache les utiliser pour accélérer son travail : explorer une idée, analyser des données, créer un prototype fonctionnel, automatiser certaines tâches ou tester une expérience utilisateur.
 L'objectif n'est pas seulement de produire des spécifications mais d'être capable de rendre rapidement une idée tangible, afin de mieux collaborer avec les utilisateurs, les designers et les ingénieurs.
 Requirements 
 Profil recherché 
 Formation Bac+5, idéalement école d'ingénieur ou formation scientifique/technique équivalente.
 Environ 3 ans d'expérience ou plus, idéalement dans un environnement produit ou technologique exigeant.
 Solide culture technique et réelle envie de comprendre comment les produits fonctionnent.
 Forte sensibilité produit et design : capacité à simplifier des problématiques complexes et à concevoir des expériences intuitives.
 Maîtrise des outils d'IA générative, notamment pour créer rapidement des prototypes, développer des fonctionnalités ou automatiser certaines tâches.
 Capacité à prototyper et à manipuler des outils techniques ; savoir coder ou avoir déjà développé des projets personnels est un vrai plus.
 Intérêt marqué pour la santé, la médecine, la santé digitale et les nouvelles technologies.
 Forte capacité analytique et aptitude à utiliser la donnée pour prendre des décisions produit.
 Excellente capacité à collaborer avec des équipes multidisciplinaires : Engineering, Design, Medical, Data et Business.
 Autonomie, curiosité et capacité à évoluer dans un environnement rapide où de nombreux sujets restent à inventer.
 Excellente maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral.
 Benefits 
 Rejoindre l'aventure Withings, c'est : 
 Intégrer l'un des pionniers et leaders mondiaux de la santé connectée, plusieurs fois primé au Consumer Electronics Show.
 Contribuer à des projets innovants et ambitieux visant à construire la santé de demain.
 Travailler dans un environnement international avec des équipes basées notamment à Issy-les-Moulineaux, Boston, Hong Kong et Shenzhen.
 Participer directement à l'amélioration de nos produits et services, notamment en les testant avant leur lancement.
 Approfondir ses connaissances médicales grâce à la Withings Med Academy et aux interventions régulières de professionnels de santé.
 Bénéficier de nombreux avantages : Stock Options, smartphone et ordinateur de votre choix, restaurant d'entreprise, avantages culturels et sportifs, et bien plus encore.
 Et surtout, rejoindre des équipes passionnées qui cherchent à avoir un impact concret sur la manière dont la santé sera suivie et prise en charge demain.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

Since its launch five years ago, Monzo Business Banking has been dedicated to delivering the very best of Monzo to small businesses. Today, it's an award-winning service, empowering over 1 million businesses across the UK. 

As Monzo expands across Europe, Business Banking is entering its next phase: adapting our products and proposition for small businesses in new markets, while continuing our mission to make money work for businesses.

The Role

We’re looking for several Senior PMMs to own Product Marketing for entire products and experiences. 

A useful distinction - at Monzo, Product Marketing starts upstream in product-market fit. We're embedded in squads with Product Managers, Data Scientists, Designers, User Researchers, and Sales, bringing the voice of the customer and market into what we build, how we position it, and how we take it to market. We own customer and market understanding, positioning, proposition, launch strategy, and sales enablement. We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead campaign strategy, creative direction, channel execution, and growth. Together, we build the right products and help them succeed in market.

This is a senior role for someone with high autonomy who loves turning dense customer and market insight into practical decisions about what should launch.
  • Business Banking. Business Banking is growing quickly, serving more than one million businesses across the UK while expanding into increasingly sophisticated customer needs. In this role, you'll shape how our products are positioned, sold, and adopted—from defining compelling product narratives to enabling Sales and partnering with Growth and Marketing on launches. jobs.title: Senior Product Owner (m/f/d) - Team Search
jobs.description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

 Flix is building the global platform for affordable and sustainable ground travel, from next-generation train offerings in Europe to rapid expansion in high-growth markets such as India. As our network becomes broader and more complex, Search plays a critical role in helping millions of customers find the right journey quickly, confidently, and intuitively. 

 As a Senior Product Owner/Manager in Demand Division you will be able to turn Search into a true growth engine for Flix: a product experience that understands customer intent, reduces complexity, improves conversion, and creates valuable demand signals for the business across web, app, and emerging AI-native channels. 

 In this role, you will define the north star for Flix Search and own the roadmap through a major product and technical transformation. You will work closely with engineering, UX, data, commercial, and operational stakeholders to evolve Search from a functional step in the booking funnel into a personalised, intelligent, and scalable discovery experience. 

 About the Role 

 
 Set and communicate a compelling product vision and strategy for Search, grounded in customer needs, business impact, and market opportunity 

 Identify and prioritise opportunities across ranking, relevance, comparison, query understanding, personalisation, and zero-result recovery 

 Use data such as conversion impact, query behaviour, and customer feedback to diagnose problems and guide product decisions 

 Lead discovery and delivery with cross-functional teams, balancing quick customer-facing improvements with long-term platform and architectural needs 

 Align stakeholders around trade-offs, success metrics, and roadmap priorities in an ambiguous and strategically important product area 

 Explore how Search can support new surfaces and behaviours, including AI-native discovery and conversational travel planning 

 
 About You 

 
 You have 8+ years of product management experience, ideally including ownership of a search, discovery, marketplace, recommendation, or other high-intent digital product 

 You have led meaningful product changes in complex environments and can connect product strategy with hands-on execution 

 You are highly data-informed and know how to turn behavioural, funnel, and query-level insights into clear product direction 

 You are comfortable partnering with engineering on technical topics such as APIs, ranking, machine learning, performance, and architectural trade-offs 

 You are a strong communicator who can build trust across engineering, UX, data, and business teams and create alignment when priorities compete 

 You are energised by unsolved problems and motivated to understand why a customer experience is not working, not only how to close the next ticket 

 You are fluent in English 

 
 Nice to have: 

 
 Experience with travel, mobility, marketplaces, e-commerce, or other high-scale consumer platforms 

 Experience building or improving AI-assisted, personalised, or conversational discovery experiences 

 German or another European language skills 

 
 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

 What We Offer 

 
 Travel perks : 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 

 Work from (M)Anywhere : Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 

 Hybrid work model : We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 

 Wellbeing support : Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 

 Learning & Development : Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 

 Mentoring Program : Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

 
 To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career 

 
 Why Join Flix? 

 At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable. 

 If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

jobs.title: Associate Product Owner
jobs.description:
TL;DR Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

 Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

 The problem you'll be solving A corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
 GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.

 What we're looking for You have personally written the tickets. 
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
 You are technical enough to argue with engineers. 
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
 You can write. 
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
 You write specs worth acting on. 
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
 You know what looks good. 
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
 You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide. 
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
 You want to be coached hard. 
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
 You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day. 
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
 You want the scope to grow. 
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.

 What you'll do Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday. 
 Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
 Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
 Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
 Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
 Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients
 
 What you'll be scoping over your first year: 
 Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
 Public REST APIs and MCP servers , so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
 AI embedded across the product , inside the surfaces people already work in.
 Workflow automation inside the platform , so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
 You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.

 Requirements 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
 Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
 Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
 Nice to have: B2B enterprise SaaS background
 Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
 Notion fluency
 
 Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.

 How we hire Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.
 Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
 Interview with the PM, including a brief intro

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Wealth & AI (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
What we do At getquin, we're on a mission to empower everyone to build wealth.
 Founded in 2020, we started with a simple idea: help people see their entire financial life in one place, so they can make more informed decisions.
 Today, getquin has grown into one of the largest wealth platforms globally, already helping over half a million users manage and grow their wealth. Our platform combines analytics, tools and community to make wealth-building accessible for everyone, not just the experts.
 After launching in Germany, we've started expanding across Europe, with a focus on growing our user base, building valuable new features and helping even more people take control of their financial future.
 If you're excited to help shape the future of personal wealth management, join us. We're just getting started.

 What you'll be doing You've built products for investors. You know what a TER actually does to a long-run return, why a user with four brokers has no visbility what they really own, and how differently people behave when the number on screen is their pension rather than their pocket money.
 You've probably also hit the ceiling of what a chart can tell someone. Better tables, more filters, another allocation donut. The data was always there; the answer never quite arrived.
 We have something nobody else has: a complete, cross-institution picture of a person's wealth. Investments, cash, liabilities and insurance contracts, in one place, for over half a million users. Your work is turning that into features and insights people understand and act on, and the interesting tools for doing that now include AI.
 We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own that area. You'll work directly with the founders and the product team, alongside engineering and our financial advisory teams. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports, and you'll mentor less experienced product managers on the team.
 Own the wealth product area end to end 
 Set the product strategy and roadmap across the picture we give people of their wealth and how we help them optimize it
 Decide what we build on aggregated portfolio data that nobody with a single-broker view could build at all
 Own our efforts to stay on the forefront of digital wealth management services and play your part in disrupting a still very offline industry
 Work the unglamorous, high-leverage problems too: data quality, coverage gaps, missing cost basis, duplicate holdings across connections, ETFs held through more than one broker. A portfolio insight is only as trustworthy as the numbers under it
 Turn the data into something users act on 
 Define the insights we surface about someone's portfolio, cash position and risk, and why each one earns a place on their screen
 Own our conversational AI assistant and our AI-driven insights: what they say, what they refuse to say, and how a user knows which is which
 Set the quality bar for anything we tell a user about their money: accuracy targets, human review, guardrails, rollback. Decide when something is good enough to ship and hold that line when the pressure is to ship anyway
 Own the numbers 
 Define the metrics for your area: activation, engagement, the insight-to-action funnel, and contribution to subscription conversion and retention
 Run the experiments, including proper A/B testing, read them, and report what didn't work alongside what did
 Live in your own product analytics and write your own queries and reporting, rather than wait for someone to give that to you
 

 What we are looking for You might be a fit if: 
 You've built wealth management, investing or portfolio products. You know the domain properly: instruments, ETFs, costs, allocation, risk, tax drag, and how retail investors actually behave rather than how they should. This is the requirement we're least flexible on
 You've owned a product area end to end against a number you defined yourself, with real experimentation behind it
 You've shipped at least one AI or LLM-based feature to production for real users, and you owned its output quality. 
 You've shipped inside a legal or compliance constraint, and you can reason about where an insight becomes advice. 
 Your product discovery produces evidence, not opinion. You can show us a real research artefact and a decision that changed because of it
 You're fluent in English; German is a plus
 You can work from our Berlin office, and you already have the right to work in Germany
 That usually adds up to around five or more years in product, but we care about the evidence, not the year count. If you came to product from engineering, data science, research, design, financial services, or from a Product Owner role, that counts. 
 Strong plus if you have: 
 PSD2, open banking or account aggregation experience
 Insurance or brokerage product exposure, which matters as we move into advisory
 Recommendation systems or personalisation at scale
 Subscription and paywall experime

jobs.title: Product Manager Intern - Platform
jobs.description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll join the Product team within Mirakl Platform, working on the Catalog Management pillar.
You'll work at the intersection of product, data, and AI: using AI to make our team faster, and helping design the AI agents our customers will use inside Mirakl.

This is a 6-month internship starting in January/February 2027. You'll participate in team rituals, gain autonomy quickly, and have the opportunity to present your work regularly to management, offering strong visibility within the organization.

Your Impact

As a Product Manager Intern, you'll play a crucial role in driving data-driven decision-making across the product organization:

  • Support the Senior Product Manager: Accompany product development end-to-end from discovery and ideation through delivery and go-to-market.
  • Design and ship AI-automated workflows for PM day-to-day tasks. Examples: automating feedback triage and synthesis, release notes and changelogs, backlog grooming, meeting-to-ticket pipelines, KPI digests, and competitive monitoring. You'll own these workflows from identifying the pain point to measuring the hours saved.
  • Contribute to the design of AI agents embedded in the Mirakl product. Work with the Senior Product Manager, Data Science, and Engineering to define customer-facing agent use cases for operators and sellers
  • Explore agentic commerce. Analyze how AI shopping and buying agents change discovery, catalog quality, pricing, and checkout on marketplaces. Map emerging standards and protocols, run small proofs of concept, and help shape product hypotheses and roadmap input
  • Drive data analysis initiatives: Define problems, prepare and preprocess data, conduct statistical analyses, and validate results to support product decisions
  • Quantify the impact of product releases: Measure and analyze the impact of new features and algorithmic changes through before/after analysis, sizing, hypothesis testing, and segmentation
  • Build and maintain performance dashboards: Create and maintain dashboards for your pillar and squads to track functional adoption and key performance indicators, including shared dashboards with Customer Success and Sales teams.

What You'll Bring to the Role

Profile & Experience

  • Currently pursuing a gap year internship, end-of-studies internship
  • Strong analytical mindset with rigorous problem definition, logical reasoning, and structured thinking
  • Solid foundation in statistics including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, and methodological choices for before/after impact analysis and group comparisons

Technical Skills

jobs.title: Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über die Position Gestalte mit uns die digitale Infrastruktur des europäischen Gartenbaus 
 Connected Growers entwickelt June: Die Plattform, über die Erzeuger, Käufer und Vermarkter effizient zusammenarbeiten. Wir ersetzen fragmentierte Prozesse durch moderne Software und schaffen eine gemeinsame digitale Infrastruktur für eine ganze Branche. 
 Dafür suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) für unseren Bereich Grower Experience, der gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design unsere Anwendung für Gartenbaubetriebe weiterentwickelt. 

 Deine Rolle bei June 
 
 Als Product Manager Grower Experience (m/w/d) verantwortest du die Produktentwicklung unserer Anwendung für Gärtner*innen. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO. 
 Deine Nutzer sind Gartenbaubetriebe, deren Bedürfnisse Du durch enge Zusammenarbeit mit diesen und weiteren Experten der Branche kennenlernst. Du entwickelst daraus technische Lösungen und Standards für die Branche.  
 Du definierst relevante KPIs für deinen Produktbereich und misst den Erfolg deiner Arbeit konsequent an ihnen. 

 Anforderungen Was du mitbringst 
 Mindestens 4–5 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement von B2B-Softwareprodukten. 

 Erfahrung im eigenständigen Führen von User Interviews, Bereitschaft zu unregelmäßigen Vor-Ort-Besuchen bei Gärtner*innen. (Führerschein erforderlich)  

 Kenntnisse gängiger Tracking- und Analytics-Tools. 

 Exzellente schriftliche Kommunikation (Roadmaps, PRDs). 

 AI-Erfahrung am Puls der Zeit: Du bist bei neuen Entwicklungen up-to-date und findest wege, wie du AI für Deine Arbeit und eingebettet im Softwareteam effizient nutzen kannst. 

 Fließend Deutsch, sehr gutes Englisch. 

 Das wäre ein Plus 
 Erfahrung mit Prozessen aus der Warenwirtschaft oder aus dem Handel.  

 Ein Software-Background kombiniert mit Product-Management-Erfahrung. 

 

 Aufgabenbereich Was du bei uns bewegst 
 Du verantwortest die Produktstrategie und -roadmap für den Bereich Grower Experience. 

 Du sprichst wöchentlich eigenständig mit unseren Gärtner*innen, baust Beziehungen zu ihnen auf und triffst die Betriebe in unregelmäßigen Abständen auch vor Ort. 

 Du arbeitest eng mit Design und Engineering zusammen, leitest gemeinsam mit Design User Interviews und übersetzt die daraus gewonnenen Erkenntnisse in konkrete Produktentscheidungen, während Du das Team fachlich durch den gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess führst. 

 Du verstehst und artikulierst den Business Value deiner Produktentscheidungen, u. a. über KPI-Frameworks, und nutzt Tracking- und Analytics-Daten, um Annahmen zu validieren und Produktentscheidungen datenbasiert zu treffen. 

 Du kommunizierst Roadmaps, PRDs und Produktentscheidungen klar und überzeugend – schriftlich wie mündlich. 

 Du nutzt AI selbstverständlich in deinem Alltag – für Prototyping, eigene Datenanalysen und einen effizienten, AI-gestützten Produktentwicklungsprozess gemeinsam mit deinem Engineering-Team. 

 Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf unser Produkt, unsere Kunden und den Erfolg von June. 

 So arbeiten wir 
 
 Unsere Produktteams verantworten ihre Bereiche vollständig: von der Produktstrategie über User Research und Priorisierung bis hin zum Release und den kommerziellen KPIs ihres Bereichs. 
 Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übernehmt ihr Verantwortung für den Erfolg eures Produktbereichs und arbeitet kontinuierlich daran, ihn zu verbessern. 
 Wir sprechen regelmäßig mit unseren Kunden, besuchen sie vor Ort und testen unsere Lösungen gemeinsam mit ihnen. Wir glauben, dass gute Produktentscheidungen nur entstehen, wenn man die Probleme der Nutzer wirklich versteht. 
 Wir arbeiten pragmatisch, treffen Entscheidungen früh und passen sie an, wenn neue Erkenntnisse entstehen. Wir haben starke Meinungen, halten aber nicht dogmatisch an ihnen fest. Verantwortung endet bei uns nicht mit dem Release. 

 Die Perspektive Was dich erwartet 
 Die Möglichkeit, Produktverantwortung für einen der zentralen Bereiche von June zu übernehmen. 

 Die Chance, den europäischen Gartenbau grundlegend zu verändern 

 Ein erfahrenes Design, Product und Engineering-Team an deiner Seite. 

 Großer Gestaltungsspielraum für Produktstrategie und Roadmap. 

 Viel Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege. 

 Modernes, AI-gestütztes Arbeiten im gesamten Produktentwicklungsprozess. 

 Die Möglichkeit, unsere Produktkultur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

 Hybrides Arbeiten in unserem Büro in Köln sowie regelmäßige Besuche bei den Gärtner*innen vor Ort. 

 Hinweis:  Die Stelle wird zunächst über Bridgemaker besetzt und im weiteren Verlauf zu Connected Growers überführt.

We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot , based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here ). 

 Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve , Qonto has grown to 1,700 Qontoers serving over 750,000 customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started. 

 Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit. 

 AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work ( here ) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

 ➡️ Mission 

 Shape how Qonto communicates with its customers by delivering a continuous, intuitive, and consistent customer experience across every channel and touchpoint, meeting regulatory obligations while turning customer communications into an efficient growth engine. You will report to Jen Christoph and build the orchestration layer behind Qonto’s numerous communication tools, giving every team a single, compliant view of what has been sent and to whom.

 Greenfield ownership: Build the shared platform—event-driven orchestration, a unified communication log, and preference management- that CRM, Operations, Compliance, and Product teams can rely on.

 Platform thinking: Turn fragmented tools and use cases into a cohesive, scalable system that teams across Qonto can easily adopt.

 Cross-functional leadership: Partner closely with CRM, Operations, Compliance, Product, and Engineering to align stakeholders and define clear scope and ownership from day one.

 Market context: Communication is shifting from distributed features to a dedicated program. You will build the connective tissue behind Qonto’s customer-communication strategy, with Regulatory, Growth, and Operations closely involved.

 Team: You will be the founding PM of a new team inside Core Experience, alongside a peer-group of PMs that also own some of Qonto’s critical UX platforms like homepage, navigation, inbox and user roles.

 Recent projects: The team is just getting started to shape the product vision - you help define the initial roadmap from day one.

 Tools: You will work across Braze, Customer.io, SendGrid, Lemlist, and Zendesk, plus the orchestration layer designed to connect them.

 
 ➡️ About you 

 
 Experience: You have senior Product Management experience and are comfortable owning a platform-level problem spanning multiple tools and internal customers.

 Communications and CRM expertise: You have worked hands-on with communication or CRM platforms such as Braze, Customer.io, or other notification or email systems, ideally across multiple tools in a real ecosystem.

 Complexity and scale: You have operated where Regulatory, Marketing, Product, and Operations teams all have competing claims on what gets sent to customers.

 Stakeholder management: You communicate clearly and confidently with senior stakeholders, building trust, aligning diverse perspectives, and influencing decisions.

jobs.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

 Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform . We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies , We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading. 
 
 About the Role: 
 Hi there! We're hiring a Senior Product Marketing Manager to join our Product Marketing team.
 We're a group that cares about getting the story right, not just getting it out the door. We work closely with product, sales, and demand gen, and we hold ourselves to a high bar because our work directly shapes how the market understands what we build.
 This role gives you real ownership. You'll shape positioning and messaging for a meaningful piece of our product portfolio, build the competitive intelligence that keeps our field teams sharp, and work directly with sales leaders who depend on your materials to close deals. It's a role with visible impact, not one where your work disappears into a shared drive.
 As a Senior Product Marketing Manager, you'll drive go-to-market strategy for your area, from positioning through launch through enablement, while partnering with product and sales to make sure the message actually lands. This role matters because clear, credible product marketing is what turns a strong platform into a business result. Camunda operates in a technical, complex space, and getting that translation right is not optional.
 What You Will Do 
 Own positioning and messaging for your product area, translating technical capability into a clear value proposition for both technical and business buyers.

 Build and maintain a competitive intelligence program that sales actually uses, not just battlecards that sit in a folder.

 Lead go-to-market execution for launches in your area, coordinating across product, sales, and demand gen so the message is consistent everywhere it shows up.

 Arm the field with content that works in real conversations: pitch decks, demos, solution briefs, and objection handling.

 Use market and customer research to inform product and positioning decisions, not just to validate ones already made.

 Mentor and support other marketers on your team, sharing what you've learned without being asked.

 What You Will Bring to the Role 
 Significant experience in B2B product marketing, ideally in enterprise software, with a track record of owning positioning and messaging end to end, not just contributing pieces of it.

 A real competitive intelligence practice under your belt. You've built and maintained a program that sales relied on, not just responded to research requests as they came in.

 Comfort marketing technical products to technical buyers. You can go deep enough into a technical concept to be credible with a developer, and simplify it enough to be clear to an executive.

 Field enablement experience at scale. You've built programs that changed how a sales team talked about a product, and you know how to tell if it worked.

 Strong cross-functional instincts. You know how to build trust with product and sales without relying on authority, and how to bring people along on a positioning decision rather than just announcing it.

 Comfort using AI tools in your day to day work. This isn't a checkbox, it's part of how the role actually operates.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA 
 Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
 Â 
 In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
 Â 
 Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.
 We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
 We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.
 If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
 
 The Role 
 KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.
 Â 
 These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.
 Â 
 The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.
 Â 
 We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.
 Â 
 What You'll Own 
 Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

 Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

 Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

 Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

 Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

 Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

 Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.
 Â 

 What We're Looking For 
 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

 Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

 Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

 Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

 Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

 Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.
 Â 

 Nice to have 
 Engineering or highly technical product background.

 Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

 Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.
 Â 

 Outcome 
 Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

 Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

 Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

 AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

 Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

 Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction
 

 Location
 This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 
 Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.
 
 Language
 English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
 
 Interview Process
 Our process is designed to move fast:
 Online assessment or practical task

 Technical interview

 CEO / final round
 

 For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

ABOUT THE ROLE 
 We are looking for a Senior HR Project Manager to join our HR Transformation team, based in our Leeds office. Reporting directly to the Director of HR Transformation, you will take ownership of high-impact people and workforce projects, and cross-functional HR frameworks.

You will bring robust project discipline, clear governance, and commercial acumen to make sure our transformation initiatives run smoothly, stay on track, and deliver real value to the wider business. This is a fantastic opportunity for a structured project professional with a strong HR background to help deliver our global HR projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
 
 YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR: 
 Leading end-to-end HR transformation projects.

 Building strong relationships and comfortably managing senior stakeholders, including Directors and C-suite members.

 Escalating risks, removing blockers, and keeping complex short- and long-term project deliverables on track.

 
 OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING: 
 
ESSENTIAL SKILLS 
 A minimum of 5+ years of experience as a Project Manager, with a strong background in or deep working knowledge of HR functions.

 Demonstrated ability to build trust and influence senior stakeholders, with the credibility to command the room.

 Exceptional communication, emotional intelligence, and conflict management skills when navigating complex change.

 Strong commercial acumen and a structured, pragmatic approach to delivering business-aligned outcomes.

 Experience working in a mature, fast-paced corporate environment (preferably across international locations).

 
 NICE TO HAVES

 WHO WE ARE

We're a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 19 offices worldwide.
 
 BENEFITS

jobs.title: Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
Lead Product Designer - Cortex 
 📍 Manchester (Hybrid, up to 4 days WFH) 
 💰 Competitive salary, dependent on experience 
  
 Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to transform the experience of buying, selling, renting and letting property, elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.
  
 Cortex is an exciting new product that brings agentic AI into Street and Spectre, taking on the busywork so agents can focus on winning instructions and building relationships. It's early, moving fast, and will ultimately touch every part of the product suite. We're looking for a Lead Product Designer to shape what agentic UX looks like across all of it.
  
 We want someone who is genuinely excited by agentic AI, past needing to be told what's worth working on, and ready to help define a product category that doesn't have a playbook yet - working closely with senior stakeholders across the business.
  
 If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you.
 At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them.

 Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask.

 We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping.

  
 Here's what you can expect to be working on 
 Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user.

 Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context.

 Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it.

 Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like.

 Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast.

  
 You should apply if: 
 You've built or shaped agentic AI, not just used AI tools - multi-step, tool-using agents you've designed, prototyped or shipped. You understand how they work and where they break.

 You've got a well-formed point of view on agentic UX - how you design for systems that don't always behave the same way, how you build in trust, transparency and control, and when to keep a human in the loop.

 You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it.

 You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief.

 You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after.

  
 You probably shouldn't apply if: 
 Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly.

 You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment.

 You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon.

 You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it.

  
 A bit about you 
 AI & agentic depth: Non-negotiable, and the first thing we'll screen for. Current, hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, with real examples of what you've built or shaped.

 Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach.

 Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain.

 Ambiguity: You do your best work when the problem isn't yet defined.

 Cross-functional: A peer at the table with product and engineering, partnering closely with a good PM without treading on each other's toes.

 Technical fluency: Being hands-on enough to prototype with code is a real advantage here, given how close design sits to how these systems work. It's a plus, not a hard requirement.

 Experience: Typically this comes with around 8+ years in product/UX design at senior IC level - but we care more about evidence you can operate at Lead altitude than the exact number, especially given how new agentic AI is. SaaS or complex product experience is helpful; property experience isn't required.

  
 Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criter

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager (US Cards)
jobs.description:
About Lendable
 Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:
 
 One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 Among the fastest-growing tech companies in the UK

 Profitable since 2017 

 Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs 

 Loved by customers with the best reviews in the market (4.9 across 10,000s of reviews on Trustpilot )

 
 So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance . We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.
 
 We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes. 
 
 Join us if you want to
 Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 Build the best technology in-house : we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting

 
 In six years, Lendable has built a profitable, market-leading credit card in the UK. In 2023, we brought that playbook to the US and set an even higher bar. This year the US credit card business scaled rapidly: our run rate grew more than 20x in the last six months.
 A lot of the work of getting customers through the door is in place. The next stage is about what happens once they’re in: helping them pay on time, giving more credit to the ones who earn it, getting people back on track when they fall behind, and ensuring an intuitive user experience across channels.
 If you're excited by fintech, lending and scaling products in a fast-moving environment, this role offers real ownership, impact and room to grow.
 
 About the role 
 We're hiring a Associate Product Manager to join the product team, and will cover post booking areas including payments, collections, credit limit increases, spend, and the mobile app.
 No two weeks look the same. One week you might be sizing an opportunity, the next week sitting with the ops team to understand why customers are calling, or putting a rough version of an idea in front of real customers before anyone builds the proper one. We care more about how quickly we learn than how polished the first attempt looks.
 
 What you'll work on 
 Running experiments across the customer lifecycle, such as how and when we remind people to pay, what gets them to set up autopay, and how we gamify engagement

 Working with credit risk and data science on how to apply models to new use cases and opportunities

 Finding cheap, fast ways to test an idea (a manual process, an email, a script) with AI before committing engineering time to it

 Gathering customer research to get truthful and unbiased reads

 Building tools and automations with AI that save time for you, the ops team and the wider business

 Doing whatever it takes to get something live, including the unglamorous parts like unblocking developers, socializing with legal and compliance, or writing the guide for the ops team
 

 What we're looking for 
 Don’t worry if you don’t meet all these criteria. We'd love to talk to any great candidate that is excited, inquisitive, and a go-getter.
 1-4 years in product, strategy, analytics, consulting or operations, with some time spent working closely to product or execution teams to deliver value

 You ask a lot of questions and you're not satisfied until you understand why something is happening

 You enjoy forming a hypothesis and finding the quickest way to test it, even if the first version is rough

 You're comfortable with data: you can write SQL or Python and answer your own questions

 You're already using AI tools like Claude Code, Cursor or Codex in your work or side projects, and you want to see how far they go

 You're happy to pick up the small jobs, understanding that as a lean product team no job is too unworthy of our attention

 You like days that look different from each other

 Bonus: experience in lending, payments, fintech or a fast-growing startup

 Keep in mind: you will not be a fit for this role if you're looking for a well-defined backlog to manage, or you'd rather wait until a problem is fully specified before starting on it. Much of what we work on starts as a loose question with multiple options possible.
 
 AI at Lendable 
 We want to build the most AI-forward financial services company in the world. PMs here make their own dashboards to answer questions that used to need an analyst, build their own agents and workflows to take care of repetitive work, and ship straightforward changes to product
