jobs.title: Junior Product Owner
jobs.description:
Your journey ROMEO is the queer company behind the legendary ROMEO dating app, one of Europe’s longest-standing dating platforms for queer communities. We are looking for a Product Owner to join our Product team in Berlin and help shape how ideas and product requirements make their way into the hands of millions of users.

In this delivery-focused role, you will work closely with Product Management, Design, Engineering, QA and BI to turn product priorities into clear, actionable work for our development teams. It is a great opportunity to grow your product skills while taking real ownership of the day-to-day delivery process.

 Your typical day Support the Product Management team in refining product requirements and translating approved PRDs into implementation-ready epics, user stories and tickets.
 Ensure user stories have clear acceptance criteria and are sufficiently refined before entering development.
 Maintain and order the backlog according to priorities set by product leadership.
 Take part in regular and ad hoc meetings to clarify product requirements with development, design and other delivery teams.
 Support our two-week delivery cycle by ensuring development teams have the information and decisions they need to proceed.
 Identify missing requirements, dependencies, open decisions and blockers early, and escalate them to Product or Delivery.
 Work closely with QA to communicate product and release priorities, clarify acceptance criteria, and support defect triage and release-readiness decisions.
 Support product acceptance and release readiness by checking delivered functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria.
 Support the BI team by translating product questions, KPIs and tracking needs into clear data requirements.
 Ensure agreed analytics requirements are captured as part of delivery, including relevant event tracking before work is considered complete.
 Maintain clear and up-to-date product documentation in Jira and Confluence.
 

 We look for You are passionate about building products for LGBTQ+ communities and interested in contributing to the continued development of ROMEO.
 You have initial experience in a Product Owner or similar product delivery role, ideally in a B2C environment. Experience in social, dating or community products is a plus. Being familiar with how our product works is a plus.
 You have experience writing or refining user stories and acceptance criteria.
 You have a good understanding of Agile product development and ideally hands-on experience with Scrum and/or Kanban.
 You are comfortable working with Jira and Confluence. Experience with Xray is a plus.
 You are organised, detail-oriented and reliable in following work through to completion.
 You proactively follow up on missing information and drive requirements towards clarity.
 You are based in Berlin or willing to relocate and are happy to work from our Wittenbergplatz office at least three days per week.
 You have excellent written and spoken English skills, ideally at a native or near-native level.
 

 What We Offer A hands-on role working on an established European digital product during a significant phase of product and technology transformation.
 Close collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, QA and BI,
 Hybrid working (3 days per week in our Berlin office at Wittenbergplatz)
 €40 employer contribution towards the Germany Job Ticket
 EGYM Wellpass (only €20/month employee contribution)
 In-house German classes
 Annual learning budget (e.g. for conferences, courses, certifications)
 International team, English-speaking environment

 Use AI to accelerate discovery, prototyping and execution without lowering quality standards.

 Collaborate with Medical on clinical validation and with QARA on quality and compliance.

 Measure adoption and impact after delivery.

 Keep Product documentation, the semantic library and required QMS evidence current.
 

 ✨ Your Team
 You will join a Product team with complementary backgrounds, working closely with Medical and Tech as one R&D organisation. The team operates across therapeutic areas: mandates evolve with priorities, and each Product Manager remains accountable for the outcome of their initiatives.

jobs.description:
About MoonPay

 MoonPay is for builders with something to prove.

 This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. 30M+ customers and 500+ ecosystem partners run on us. Licensed in the U.S. Regulated across the UK, EU, Canada, and Australia.

 AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

 You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

 The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building for what's next, for humans and agents. 

 Recent recognition:
 

 
 Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 . 
2nd in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100 
 The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running

 About the Opportunity 

 
 
 In this role, you will own the roadmap for the systems that establish and verify who a MoonPay customer is, from sign-in through KYC clearance. This spans authentication (sign-in, MFA, session security), identity verification (KYC tiers, risk scoring, sanctions screening), and document verification, the vendor-driven flows that sit inside the KYC funnel.

 
 You will sit within the Identity team and work closely with Compliance, Risk/Fraud, Legal, and Engineering, as well as the third-party identity verification vendors MoonPay relies on.

 
 Your work will directly impact onboarding conversion, fraud loss, and MoonPay's ability to operate compliantly across multiple countries, balancing customer experience against risk and regulatory requirements on every decision.

 
 This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to own a product area where user experience, fraud risk, and hard regulatory constraints all collide, and who's motivated by getting that balance right rather than optimizing for just one of the three.

 
 What You Will Do 

 
 
 Own the roadmap for authentication and identity verification, prioritizing across conversion, fraud/risk reduction, and regulatory requirements.

 
 Drive improvements to onboarding funnels, reducing drop-off in document capture and verification while maintaining or improving fraud and conversion rates.

 
 Manage and evaluate third-party KYC/IDV vendor relationships, including performance, cost, and regional coverage.

 
 Partner with Compliance and Legal to translate regulatory requirements into product specs and rollout plans.

 
 Work with Engineering to ship changes to authentication flows without introducing account-takeover or fraud exposure.

 
 Define and track funnel metrics.

 
 Represent Identity in cross-functional planning with Risk, Fraud, Compliance, and Legal stakeholders.

 
 About You 

 Must-have experience and skills 

 
 
 4+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time spent on identity verification, KYC/AML, fraud, or authentication/security products.

 
 Working familiarity with KYC/AML concepts and authentication concepts.

 
 Experience managing or evaluating third-party identity/KYC vendors.

 
 Comfort operating in a regulated, multi-region environment where the same feature behaves differently by jurisdiction.

 
 Nice-to-have experience 

 
 
 Background in fintech, crypto, or another regulated marketplace.

 
 Experience with sanctions screening, PEP/adverse media checks, or transaction monitoring.

 
 Bonus Points 

 
 
 Experience with crypto-native authentication (wallet-based sign-in, sign-in with Ethereum) or crypto compliance requirements.

New Challenge About Us 
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a defence technology company with offices in Berlin and Munich, and a trusted partner of the German Armed Forces. Our customers field sensors, drones and C2 systems from many vendors that were never built to work together. We build Hydris, an orchestration layer that integrates the systems they already field, and the ones they'll add next, into one picture operators can act on across defence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Hydris runs at the edge, keeps working when the link drops, and its core is open source under Apache 2.0.

As Senior Product Manager for Mission Devices, you'll own the hardware that puts Hydris in the field. 

You'll work end-to-end, from discovery with operators through hardware build cycles to fielded units, and you'll decide what gets built rather than work through someone else's backlog. The bar is concrete: devices that run for months off-grid in contested RF environments.

What you'll do
 Discovery and requirements Spend time with end users in their operating environment to understand their workflows in depth, not just their stated requirements.
 Validate assumptions about value, usability, feasibility and viability through prototypes, bench tests and field trials before committing to hardware fabrication.
 Analyze contractual specifications with Program Managers, separating firm constraints from areas where there's room for the best technical solution.
 Roadmap and delivery Maintain an outcome-focused roadmap aligned to hardware build cycles (EVT/DVT/PVT), firmware releases and OTA update pipelines.
 Define requirements and field metrics for each device, including detection performance, energy efficiency, mission endurance and SWaP, and make the trade-offs between them.
 Prioritize investment across the device family, deciding where to extend existing devices and where a new one is needed.
 Systems and interoperability Make sure devices integrate with Hydris as and interoperate with third-party systems through industry standards and protocols.
 Design provisioning, commissioning and deployment workflows that are simple and reliable in the field.
 Investigate issues that span hardware, firmware and communications, and work with engineering to resolve them.
 Collaboration Act as the main source of product context and the product's champion, making sure the team, leadership and customers understand what we're building and why.
 Work in a product trio with engineering (hardware and ML) and design. 
 Partner with Program and Capture Managers to keep the product vision aligned with contractual commitments.
 Write clear PRDs and decision records, and mentor teammates on discovery practice and hardware–software trade-offs.
 
You should apply if you have

jobs.description:
Who we are: 
 We're one of Europe's fastest-growing fintech companies – on a mission to create the world's most empowering way to pay.
 We launched the product in 2020 and achieved double unicorn status, valued at $2 billion, and since then have taken on more than 6 million customers.
  
 Our mission is to become the best way to pay for anything, anywhere and say goodbye to credit costs for everyone. This is huge. Want to join us?
 About The Role. 
 You will lead a team of ~3-4 product analysts for our Customer Growth and Lifecycle domain, owning narrative and insights and driving sustainable customer customer growth. You will be a thought partner with a Director of Product and you will influence roadmap and product decisions, and also work cross-functionally day-to-day with Marketing, Risk, Finance and the rest of Data.
 
The scope runs from acquisition source and sign-up, through credit approval, activation, repeat usage, arrears behaviour, retention, and cohort profitability. You'll need to be as comfortable talking about loss rates and payback periods as you are about conversion funnels and retention curves, and tie everything we’re doing to commercial outcomes.

You will be a hands-on leader solving some of the most complex customer and business problems, while also managing a team of ~3-4 product analysts. You will be someone who thrives at using complex data and intuition to drive business outcomes, ensuring data is a core driver of company strategy.
 
 What you’ll be doing day to day. 
 Own the analytics strategy for the Customer Lifecycle domain - from acquisition quality through activation, retention, and cohort profitability - translating the company-wide analytics vision into a focused plan for your team.

 Operate horizontally across Lifecycle squads: your analysts are already embedded, so your job is to connect the dots, spot patterns across teams, and ensure the collective effort ladders up to domain commercial goals.

 Know the key commercial drivers inside out - cohort payback, contribution margin, funnel economics, risk-adjusted value - so you can direct work with conviction and challenge outputs with authority.

 Build experimentation capability within the domain pragmatically - establish clear hypotheses, decision criteria, and honest readouts as the norm for your teams.

 Increase stakeholder self-sufficiency through dashboards and shared frameworks - freeing your analysts from reactive requests and shifting their time towards high-value proactive work.

 Grow and focus your team - coach analysts, raise the technical bar, and create clarity on what good looks like for the domain.

 Be the primary analytics partner for Lifecycle product leadership - earning trust by consistently surfacing what matters, not just what's been asked for.

 Raise the standard of evidence in domain product decisions - moving from opinion-led to evidence-led, one decision at a time.

  
 What We're Looking For. 
 Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment and embrace change as an opportunity.

 6+ years in product analytics or insight-focussed roles (start-up or scale-up pace) and 2+ years leading a team of analysts.

 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and present complex findings succinctly.

 You're comfortable with credit risk concepts: loss rates, approval rates, unit economics. You don't need to be a risk modeller, but you can't be allergic to the topic.

 Strong technical foundation in analytics with advanced SQL. You can model data, design experiments, and have a proper technical conversation if required

 Comfortable operating at both strategic and tactical levels, able to “zoom in” on critical insights while maintaining a holistic view.

 You've built experimentation programmes - not just run one-off tests, but established how a team thinks about evidence.

 You're opinionated about what matters, but you update your views when the data says otherwise.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
We're on a mission 
 Every business grows through a CRM and a direct line to its customers. Healthcare, and pharmacy most of all, is the one place that never happened. It was too hard to build, too hard to distribute, and too hard to do compliantly. Customer data sits idle whilst running a community healthcare business continues to become structurally tighter.
  
 We're on a mission to change that. We are the compliant data layer for community healthcare: the system that lets a pharmacy use the patient data it already holds to grow revenue and relationships, compliantly, on the clinical system it already runs.
  
 This is already working. Pharmlogic is NHS-assured, integrated and lives in hundreds of pharmacies nationwide, and we've powered millions of patient communications.
  
 The role 
 You will run marketing across the board: brand and social, the website, copy across everything we put out, how we explain the product, and the campaigns that keep our pharmacy customers engaged. You own the channels and you set the standard for how Pharmlogic sounds and looks.
  
 You report to the CEO and work closely with the founding team. This is a hands-on role for a generalist who can write, ship, and run several channels at once without waiting to be told. You are early, and the function is yours to shape.
  
 The problems you'll own 
  
 Carrying the message: Take our vision, the why behind Pharmlogic, and make it land with the people we exist for. You translate what we believe into words that busy healthcare teams trust and can act on.

 Communicating in a regulated space: Everything we put out can be read by healthcare professionals, other stakeholders and by patients. You write with the clarity, accuracy and care that demands, where compliant and compelling are the same standard, not a trade-off.

 Our voice, everywhere: Own how Pharmlogic sounds across social, the website, campaigns and the product itself. One voice, centred on the vision, consistent wherever someone meets us.

 From product to message: Turn what we build into messaging tailored to all stakeholders in a busy healthcare team that can be immediately understood. You make the complex simple without sacrificing value.

 The customer journey: Own the communications that take a pharmacy from signed to thriving, engaged, getting full value, and staying, so the story we tell is the experience they have.

 Knowing what works: Measure what you put out, double down on what performs, and feed what you learn back into how we market, sell and build.

 Pharmlogic in the room: with the team at sector events, from the stand and the materials to the follow-up, so the people we meet in person get the same clear story as everyone else, and conversations turn into pipeline.

  
 This could be for you if 
  
 You're an excellent communicator, above all. Writing is the craft at the centre of this job. You make complex things simple without making them shallow, you have taste, and it shows in everything you put out.

 You've done lifecycle and product marketing in high-pace SaaS. You know how to take what a product does and turn it into a message people act on, and how to run the journey from signed customer to engaged advocate. That experience is what lets you move fast here from day one.

 You thrive on the team's success. You get more from a customer win or a teammate's great launch than from your own byline. Small team, shared scoreboard.

 You share the vision. You believe every healthcare business should be able to understand its customers and improve care for them while staying viable. If that sentence resonates rather than reads as marketing, this will feel like your work, not just a job.

 You ship at startup pace. You put things out, learn, and go again, rather than polishing one thing for a month, and you do it without waiting for a brief.

 Tooling fluency helps. Comfort with a CMS, email platforms, CRMs and basic design is a real advantage.

  
 What you'll get 
 You'll be joining a fast-growing company and a small, sharp team focused on making community healthcare thrive.
 Competitive salary + up to £5,000 in share options 

 Private medical insurance

 Flexible, hybrid working

 28 days of holiday plus bank holidays, and up to 4 weeks a year working from anywhere

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Business Applications Development)
jobs.description:
Are you looking to own the customer-facing experience for JetBrains products, from how individuals and organizations buy and manage software to how licensing and entitlements work behind the scenes?

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

In this role, you’ll lead the strategy for BAD (Business Application Development) Product. You’ll tackle the complex web of purchases, subscriptions, organization administration, and usage-based services, making sure our customers have a smooth, coherent experience every step of the way.

You’ll work closely with engineering, design, analytics, QA, and BAD Platform, as well as Sales, Customer Success, and Finance teams. You’ll have the autonomy to drive product discovery, validate hypotheses through data and experimentation, and define the long-term vision for our licensing and administration ecosystem.

Day to day, you will:

  • Define and execute the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for BAD Product systems.
  • Uncover user friction through customer research, support data, telemetry, and feedback from internal teams.
  • Map and improve end-to-end customer journeys covering purchasing, subscriptions, licensing, and administration.
  • Identify gaps, overlaps, and inconsistencies across sub-systems to build a clear, unified user experience.
  • Partner with engineering, design, analytics, and QA from early discovery through launch and continuous iteration.
  • Define and track key product metrics for adoption, conversion, and support demand.
  • Communicate product direction, trade-offs, and progress clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

What you’ll bring

  • An ownership mindset, taking responsibility for outcomes, not just task completion.
  • A clear focus on underlying problems and desired outcomes rather than immediate feature requests.
  • Comfort with technical complexity, trade-offs, and systems thinking.
  • A preference for quality, long-term sustainability, and user trust over short-term fixes.
  • The ability to make grounded decisions using customer research, analytics, and experimentation.
  • Strong collaboration skills across multi-disciplinary teams and distinct business areas.

What you’ll need

  • A proven track record of managing technically complex SaaS, enterprise, or B2B product areas end to end.
  • Hands-on experience driving product discovery, user research, and roadmap prioritization.
  • Experience navigating complex customer journeys, multi-team dependencies, and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience making data-informed decisions using telemetry, product metrics, and experimentation.
  • The ability to work comfortably alongside engineering teams on technical details, APIs, data models, and system integrations.
  • Fluency in English.

What success looks like

In practice, success means building a licensing and administration experience that feels seamless to the user and resilient under the hood. You'll bring clarity to ambiguous systems, simplify fragmented customer flows, and establish reliable product metrics. Ultimately, you succeed by removing friction for millions of developers and admins, allowing them to focus on their actual work.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary – We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedule – Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Extra time off – More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Learning and development opportunities – Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Relocation support – Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
  • Free meals and snacks – Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
  • Health and wellness – On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
  • Internal events – Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

If this sounds like you, we’d love to read your application.

*Some benefits may vary depending on location.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Preclinical Device
jobs.description:
Location : London, with occasional travel. 
  
 About Netholabs
 Netholabs builds large-scale neural and behavioural recording platforms to generate the data needed for the next generation of brain models. We operate two recording platforms: a preclinical ethological monitoring system integrated with behaviour and neural data and a human motion-capture and neurophysiology platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where hardware, neuroscience, and ML sit in the same room.
  
 The Role
 We are building integrated human motion-capture and neurophysiological recording systems for both controlled lab studies and naturalistic, in-the-wild data collection. Today we have working prototypes. We need someone to turn them into products - reproducible, manufacturable, remotely updatable systems that can be deployed at scale and maintained without an engineer in the room.
 You will own R&D delivery across the London lab and hardware programme: co-developing the hardware with our electronics and mechanical engineers, importing and enforcing best-practice data capture protocols, and engaging contract manufacturers to scale. This is an agentic, hands-on role -with support engineer roles as required. You will spend as much time in the lab and on the phone with suppliers as you will in a spec document.
  
 What you'll do
 Take working prototypes to shippable, field-deployable systems — define the product, own the roadmap, and drive it to delivery

 Specify and build out over-the-air update infrastructure: firmware, versioning, rollback, fleet management, remote diagnostics

 Own the design-for-manufacture transition — DFM/DFA reviews, BOM ownership, tolerancing, test fixtures, and production test protocols

 Identify, qualify, and manage contract manufacturers and suppliers; own the relationship from RFQ through NPI to sustained production

 Establish and enforce best-practice data capture protocols across modalities (EEG, fNIRS, EMG, pupillometry, motion capture, video) so that data quality is consistent across sessions, operators, and sites

 Define the requirements that make in-the-wild collection viable: wearability, session setup time, robustness, battery life, and unattended operation

 Work directly with our electronics, mechanical, firmware, and neuroscience teams to translate research needs into hardware requirements — and push back when a requirement doesn't survive contact with manufacturing

 Build the quality, documentation, and regulatory groundwork (design history, ISO 13485-style discipline, CE/UKCA pathway) appropriate to a research-device product

 Contribute to the industrialisation of our rodent recording platform where the manufacturing and OTA problems overlap
  

 What we're looking for
 Essential
 Min 3+ years (ideal 7+) in hardware product management, product engineering, or programme management, with several products you personally took from prototype to volume manufacture 

 Direct, demonstrable experience with contract manufacturers: you have run RFQs, sat through NPI builds, argued about yield, and fixed a production line problem from 6,000 miles away

 Deep understanding of connected-device architecture: OTA update mechanisms, device provisioning, telemetry, fleet management, and what it costs to get these wrong

 Fluency across electronics, mechanical, and firmware enough to hold a real technical conversation with each - you don't need to design the board, but you need to know when the answer you're getting is wrong

 Track record of writing specifications and protocols that people actually follow

 Comfort with ambiguity and a small-company reality: no PMO, no roadmap tooling team, no one to delegate the boring parts to

 Strongly preferred 
 Experience with wearable, biosignal, or medical device hardware

 Familiarity with human research data collection — protocols, participant handling, IRB/ethics, GDPR and special-category data

 Experience shipping a product to CE/UKCA or FDA pathway

 Background in neuroscience, biomedical engineering, or a related field

 Experience with multi-sensor time synchronisation and the data infrastructure behind it

 What we offer
 Direct ownership of a product line at a company small enough that your decisions ship

 Equity in an early-stage company building foundational infrastructure for brain modelling

 A team of neuroscientists and engineers doing genuinely novel work

 Central London lab, on-site, with access to the Sussex rodent facility

 To apply: send a CV and a short note about a product you took from prototype to manufacture what broke, and what you did about it.

We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here. 

Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.


 

À propos de Cognite

Cognite est un éditeur mondial de logiciels d'intelligence artificielle industrielle qui accompagne les secteurs à forte intensité d'actifs dans leur transformation numérique à grande échelle. Notre plateforme phare, Cognite Data Fusion®, combinée à nos solutions d’intelligence artificielle générative et agentique (Atlas AI et Cognite Flows), convertit des données industrielles complexes en indicateurs exploitables en temps réel.

Notre ambition : générer 100 milliards de dollars de valeur concrète pour nos clients d'ici 2035. Pour atteindre cet objectif, nous veillons à ce que nos technologies de pointe se traduisent par une appropriation opérationnelle réelle, pérenne et ancrée dans le quotidien de nos clients.

Le poste

Rejoignez une équipe qui façonne l’avenir de l’industrie grâce à l’IA. En tant que Value & Adoption Lead, votre mission principale sera de pérenniser l’appropriation des solutions Cognite au sein de nos comptes stratégiques les plus complexes.

Avec des milliers d’utilisateurs actifs sur le terrain, des installations industrielles multiples et des produits de données en production, nos partenariats de co-innovation majeurs s'inscrivent dans des transformations de l'IA sur plusieurs années.

Dans ce rôle, vous ferez le pont entre le déploiement technique et la concrétisation de la valeur métier. En étroite collaboration avec les clients et l'équipe des comptes stratégiques, vous pilotez de bout en bout l’intégration de nos technologies — telles que l’IA agentique, Flows et Adaptive Expériences — dans le quotidien opérationnel des ingénieurs sur site, des planificateurs de maintenance et des équipes de direction.

  • Piloter la création et le suivi de la valeur : Garantir la trajectoire de valeur à travers quatre dimensions clés du compte (Rétention → Activation des utilisateurs → Intégration dans les processus de travail → Mesure des résultats business).   • Structurer la démarche d'accompagnement et d'adoption : Transformer les actions de support ponctuelles en un programme d'adoption formalisé, reproductible et déployable à grande échelle. Concevoir des parcours ciblés via Cognite Academy, mettre en place des formations de formateurs et encadrer les phases de transition vers un support renforcé.
  • Fédérer un réseau de référents internes : Identifier, mobiliser et former les relais d’opinion et utilisateurs clés sur chaque site pour assurer l'autonomie à long terme du client.
  • Diagnostiquer et lever les blocages : Mener des analyses rigoureuses en cas de ralentissement de l'utilisation des outils (formation, ergonomie, processus internes). Coordonner les équipes transverses — Delivery, ingénierie terrain, Academy et Customer Success — pour lever rapidement ces obstacles.

Dein Fokus liegt zu einhundert Prozent auf der Betreuung, Pflege und redaktionellen Weiterentwicklung komplexer digitaler Webplattformen. Du verantwortest den langfristigen und nachhaltigen Betrieb unserer digitalen Produkte. Als Senior bist du das strategische und organisatorische Rückgrat für unsere Content Teams sowie UX Designer und stellst sicher, dass neue Inhalte strukturiert, geprüft und pünktlich live gehen.

 Deine Aufgaben 
Du übernimmst die operative Steuerung und die strategische Planung von großen digitalen Pflegeprojekten sowie weltweiten Content Rollouts. Dabei agierst du als zentrale und souveräne Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden, der Kreation und den redaktionellen Teams.
Dein Arbeitsalltag ist geprägt von agilen Methoden. Du übersetzt komplexe inhaltliche Anforderungen in klare Aufgabenpakete, führst das Backlog und koordinierst die Sprints sicher über Jira. Für eine saubere Dokumentation und den transparenten Wissenstransfer nutzt du Confluence.
Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für Content Management Systeme und steuerst die kontinuierliche Pflege sowie redaktionelle Befüllung der Plattform. Qualität ist für dich kein Zufall. Du planst umfassende Abnahmen für Texteingaben und Bildmaterial und gibst keine neuen Seiten live, die nicht unseren hohen Standards entsprechen.
Du behältst Timings, Ressourcen und Budgets für die kontinuierliche Betreuung der Plattform stets im Blick. Als Senior bewahrst du auch in stressigen Phasen einen kühlen Kopf und leitest dein Projektteam sicher durch komplexe Publikationsprozesse.

 Dein Profil Erfahrung: Du hast langjährige Erfahrung im digitalen Projektmanagement gesammelt und dabei große Webplattformen oder redaktionelle Rollouts hauptverantwortlich gesteuert.
 Plattform Wissen: Du kennst dich hervorragend mit modernen Content Management Systemen aus und verstehst die Prozesse hinter erfolgreicher digitaler Redaktion und Plattformpflege.
 Agilität: Du bist ein absoluter Profi im Umgang mit agilen Arbeitsweisen und steuerst Workflows routiniert über Jira und Confluence.
 Leadership: Du sprichst die Sprache der Content Creator genau so fließend wie die der Kunden. Du trittst absolut sicher auf und führst dein Projektteam mit klarer Orientierung.
 Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest extrem strukturiert, bringst eine hohe Lösungsorientierung mit und bewahrst bei umfassenden Content Rollouts stets die Ruhe.
 Sprache: Neben deinen fließenden Deutschkenntnissen kommunizierst du auch auf Englisch absolut sicher und verbindlich.
 

 Warum wir? Bei uns erwartet dich ein attraktiver Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von St. Pauli verbunden mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten
 Du triffst auf eine offene Agenturkultur, die von Kreativität und Menschlichkeit geleitet ist
 Der respektvolle Umgang miteinander auf Augenhöhe ist bei uns Prinzip
 Bei uns hast du Eigenverantwortung und wirst zu selbstständigem Arbeiten motiviert
 Du wirst inhaltlich geführt und hast Raum für deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung
 Du profitierst von unserer globalen DDB-Trainingsplattform mit umfangreichen Fachthemen und Skill-Trainings (u.a. LinkedIn Learning und Babbel)
 Förderung deiner Mobilität (Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets sowie Kooperation mit Jobrad) 
 Mit Angeboten, wie einer Kooperation mit dem PME-Familienservice sowie Wellhub, wollen wir deine Gesundheit unterstützen
 Leckeres Frühstück mit frischem Brot an deinen Bürotagen
 Du hast die Möglichkeit, regelmäßig von zu Hause zu arbeiten 
 

 Unser Standort Wir sind in St.Pauli, im Zirkusweg zwischen Reeperbahn und Elbe. Zwischen schreienden Möwen und gemeinsamen Abenden in den berüchtigtsten und liebenswertesten Kneipen auf dem Kiez. Immer im Austausch, gerne auch im 19. Stock. Dann reden wir darüber, was wir noch nicht gesehen haben. Was wir vorhaben und wie wir das zusammen schaffen.
